synthesizedFacts.fact: Red undertones in skin are often mistaken for conditions like rosacea, but they are a natural part of the skin's structure and do not change with external factors.
Green color correctors are effective in neutralizing red undertones because green is opposite red on the color wheel.
Skin undertones are categorized as cool, warm, or neutral, and they remain constant regardless of changes in skin tone.
The vein test, jewelry test, and white paper test are common methods to determine skin undertones.
